projects.title: Ancient Char Lookup
projects.oneLiner: CLI + Web tool for ancient Chinese script lookup — printable Oracle/Bronze/Seal comparison tables
projects.outcome: Local CLI: 1.7s end-to-end on 1,233 chars, 99.6% match rate against 13,714-char EVOBC dataset. Mid-build discovered ccamc.org anti-bot CAPTCHA blocking the Web data source — re-architected the Web product from “fetch-and-render comparison table” to “navigation table with 4 authoritative source links”, kept CLI as the recommended path. Documented the architectural pivot in README.
projects.oneLiner_zh: 古文字字源查询工具：粘贴汉字 → 一键生成「甲骨/金文/战国/篆书」可打印对照表
projects.outcome_zh: 本地 CLI 1.7 秒处理 1,233 字，命中 EVOBC 13,714 字数据集 99.6%。开发途中实测发现 ccamc.org 对密集请求触发验证码反爬 → 主动重构 Web 端定位（从「在线抓取对照表」改为「四大字源库导航表」），CLI 作为主推交付。架构决策完整写入 README。
